{% trans "Received URL" %}
{% channel_callback channel "receive" %}
{% blocktrans trimmed %} When a new message is received by your service, it should notify us with a POST to the following URL, passing the following parameters: 'from' and 'text'. Callers can optionally also send a 'date' parameter in ISO-8601 (ex: 2012-04-23T18:25:43.511Z) format to specify the time the message was received. {% endblocktrans %}
{% trans "Example" %}
POST {% channel_callback channel "receive" %}
from=%2B250788123123&text=Love+is+patient.+Love+is+kind.&date=2012-04-23T18:25:43.511Z
{% trans "Sent URL" %}
{% channel_callback channel "sent" %}
{% blocktrans trimmed %} When your service successfully sends a message, it should notify us with a POST to the following URL, passing the uuid of the message as the parameter 'uuid' (reporting sent messages is optional) {% endblocktrans %}
{% trans "Example" %}
POST {% channel_callback channel "sent" %}
uuid=019a25a3-2014-7e3b-8422-c53b747c390f
{% trans "Delivered URL" %}
{% channel_callback channel "delivered" %}
{% blocktrans trimmed %} When your service successfully delivers a message, it should notify us with a POST to the following URL, passing the uuid of the message as the parameter 'uuid' (reporting deliveries is optional) {% endblocktrans %}
{% trans "Example" %}
POST {% channel_callback channel "delivered" %}

{% trans "Failed URL" %}
{% channel_callback channel "failed" %}
{% blocktrans trimmed %} If your service fails to send an outgoing message, it should notify us with a POST to the following URL, passing the uuid of the message as the parameter 'uuid' (reporting failed sends is optional) {% endblocktrans %}
{% trans "Example" %}
POST {% channel_callback channel "failed" %}

{% channel_callback channel "stopped" %}
